scientific_hypothesis: Cboe-exchange total SOXX option activity, scaled by its own lagged baseline and price-volume context, may indicate next-session tail risk without a directional put/call interpretation. This is distinct from CBOE SKEW, price trend, realized variance and prior constituent leads. No factor is tested here.
comparison_api: Qlib D.calendar only; no price/return outcome reads
source_boundary: Cboe four exchanges only; total contracts, no put/call/open-close/position, not all US options. Availability at 09:46 on next day is unproven by retrospective file; forward capture required before trading-grade PIT claim. Recent date presence is not first-public timing.
acceptance: Exact query, response, content type, SHA256, retrieval time archived
Schema exact and both symbols mapped
Calendar coverage per full year plus missing/zero/duplicate days using Qlib D.calendar
Cross-exchange field consistency and explicit Cboe-only scope
Recent available date reported without claiming first-public time
stops: Non-CSV or schema mismatch: preserve and stop
Response >8MB or server denial: preserve failure and stop
No downstream model, threshold or account from this plan
